_provenance: Error bodies observed live 2026-09-16 on a Jira Cloud site while capturing Phase 14 write evidence against a disposable issue. invalid_transition_id came from POST /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/transitions with a transition id not valid for the issue (400). unknown_field came from PUT /rest/api/3/issue/{key} sending one unknown field together with one malformed known field (400): Jira reported only the unknown field and rejected the whole request, leaving the valid field unapplied. unknown_issue came from POST /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/comment against an issue key that does not exist (404), and does not distinguish a missing issue from a permission denial. All tenant, key, and id values are synthesized.
